fields.expertises-hero-text-html-2: The questions that leisure park managers ask us :
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html: How does table ordering via QR code work?
fields.rt-faq-html: Each table or zone is equipped with a unique QR code. Visitors scan it with their smartphone to access a personalized ordering interface, with no application to download. They can view the menu, order and pay directly from their phone.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-2: Why equip your leisure space with Innovorder?
fields.rt-faq-html-2: Innovorder offers a suite of solutions designed for the complex flows and peak use of leisure facilities. Central checkout, autonomous ordering, mobile payment: everything is synchronized, fluid and customizable. You gain in efficiency, your visitors spend less time waiting, and your sales naturally increase.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-3: Can I track my activity in real time?
fields.rt-faq-html-3: Yes, the Innovorder back-office lets you monitor your sales, by zone or by product, in real time. You can visualize your performance, adjust your teams or your offer according to traffic, and manage your entire site remotely.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-4: Why is the Innovorder cash register essential for using other solutions?
fields.rt-faq-html-4: The Innovorder cash register is the heart of our ecosystem: it centralizes all order data, collects cash and ensures perfect synchronization. It enables you to manage your business easily, and with reliable data.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-5: What solutions are available to equip my leisure space?
fields.rt-faq-html-5:
Innovorder offers an ecosystem designed for the specific needs of leisure areas:

  • Cash register: manage your orders simultaneously from a single tool, even at peak times. Use our mobile cash register to cash your orders directly at your place of business.
  • Ordering at the table via QR code: your customers can order without leaving their activity, streamlining service and boosting sales volume. They can enjoy their favorite leisure activities without interruption.
  • Order kiosk: ideal at the entrance, near the snack bar or directly on the activities to capture all stand-alone orders and avoid queuing at the counter.
  • Production display (KDS): instantly displays orders in the kitchen or at the bar, for faster, error-free service.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-6: What are the advantages of a mobile cash register?
fields.rt-faq-html-6: The mobile cash register allows your teams to move around freely, taking orders and cashing up wherever they like, with no constraints. This reduces unnecessary travel, improves service time and frees up time for customer relations. It's also a real productivity booster during busy periods.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-7: Can I manage my leisure activities and bookings with Innovorder?
fields.rt-faq-html-7: No, the Innovorder cash register is dedicated to catering management only. It cannot be used to manage leisure area reservations. Our solution focuses on cash collection, order taking and smooth service within your catering space.
